title: Quality indexes Q2: ship rate, deadline and system-fail rate, change locality and the comparison MDE, each with an interval
summary: PQ1, PQ3, PQ4 and CQ2 have data today but no reader. Baselines on 2026-10-21: PQ1 64.0% [56.9, 70.5] over waves 82 to 140; deadline 16.7% [12.0, 22.7]; system-fail 4.8% [2.6, 8.9]; median 2 packages per ship. run.json final_verdict is not a reliable outcome (cycle 2024 says PASS, its seal says FAIL). Spec: docs/architecture/llm-quality-indexes.md §8 and CQ2 in §6.
fix: Readers in internal/qualitypanel: wave membership from .evolve/waves/wave-N.json cycle_floor; ship from run.json shipped or the ship.landed signal; deadline from a missing cycle.sealed or a lane-deadline seal; system-fail from the codes in spec PQ4; CQ2 from ship-binding.json commit_sha and git show --numstat. Add evolve quality compare --index <id> --a <window> --b <window> with the MDE and a McNemar exact test for paired windows.
acceptance: RED first: a cycle-2024 shape (run.json PASS, cycle.sealed FAIL, no ship) counts as not shipped
A fixture of waves 137 to 140 reproduces 2/5, 1/6, 2/5, 3/5 and their Wilson bounds
PQ4 counts a run directory with no cycle.sealed signal as a deadline end
evolve quality compare reports status=inconclusive when the observed difference is under the MDE
Each Q2 reading carries the 11 keys of spec §5.2 with the window and source of its reader
evolve quality compare on a paired fixture with 8 discordant pairs (7 to 1) reports the exact McNemar p-value
